description: The last F-1 built and the second F-1 displayed at Tsuiki
Moved for construction work and currently not viewable
Flown in from Gifu on 15 Mar 2021 and struck off here; parked behind the hangars pending a permanent display site and moved from time to time; around 33.6763N 131.04E in late 2024
Fin of the aircraft that crashed off Hagi on 11 Sep 2008 with the pilot surviving; kept as a monument that visitors tend to sit on
surface_to_air Complete round with booster and launcher inside the 7th Fire Unit compound at 33.6764N 131.6928E about 1.5 km SW of the runway
